hypothesis: W-R35's reproducible asymmetric-reference advantage may be tied to the original byte-codebook rather than a transferable temporal ordering primitive. Freeze development-only W-R34 weights and test both pretrained representations under invertible label-preserving byte/channel transforms applied equally to the raw reference and quantized observation. No weights or features are refit.
freeze: Freeze fresh seeds1600..1631, bit depth4, four nonidentity invertible coordinate transforms plus identity, six heldout generator/site cells and every classification gate before first-use. No unseen cohort screening, fitting or retuning.
original_frozen_development_seeds: 1184..1199 W-R34 only; no new training and no previous heldout evaluation used as fit
quantization: Pinned W-R32 top-4-bit quantizer applied to observation BEFORE the format transform; transformation T acts on raw reference and already quantized observation, not on labels or swap order
transforms: channel_rotate: rotate four channel tuple left one
arms: asymmetric_refit: original W-R34 development-frozen raw-reference vs observation 16-wide model
symmetric_refit: original W-R34 development-frozen matched-codec reference 16-wide model
primary: Report each transform's paired TP/TN/FP/FN and observationally identical pairs for 32 seeds, 3 frozen generator families and two swap sites. Define loss per arm as accuracy(identity)-accuracy(transform) on exactly matched seeds. CODEBOOK_SENSITIVE iff at least two nonidentity transforms each lose >=0.10 in either arm; PARTIAL if at least one loses >=0.10; TRANSFER_STABLE otherwise. Explicitly retain transformations with improvements.
controls: All transforms are bijective 4-channel bytes, do not alter class labels or order; both raw reference and candidate transformed in same way
Same fixed W-R34 1728 historical training examples, 32 epochs, 16 weights+bias and exact features; evaluation-only changes
No source birth independence claims beyond fresh deterministic seed cohorts; no model calls, oracle, unseen training or heldout repetitions
One original evidence artifact followed by full Go test/build; no accepted refs or production writes
claim_limit: Synthetic zero-shot byte-relabeling transfer, not raw-language generalization.
